messages:
Dana (Billing): Noticed a string of micro chargebacks for new merchant Onboardly (acct_OBD12). 9 disputes for <$5 in the last 6h. dsp ids start dsp_m1..dsp_m9.
Marco (Risk): Micro chargebacks often indicate card-testing/fraud. Any common BINs or IPs?
Dana (Billing): Preliminary: 6 different card BINs but same customer email pattern (test+*@onboardly.co) and same shipping name 'QA Test'.
chargeback-bot: Alert: multiple_micro_chargebacks_detected for acct_OBD12. Risk score: 86%. Recommend holding payouts & blocking new onboarding payments. :warning:
Pri (FinOps): Put next payout on manual hold. Also need ledger snapshot and net exposure.
Jules (Support): Reached out to merchant success contact asking for onboarding logs and confirmation of test accounts — they replied: "We ran an internal QA script last night, unintentionally hitting prod." They attached a short script snippet.
Marco (Risk): Ask for signed attestation and exact timestamps for the QA run. Also request their webhook and auth logs to confirm origin IPs. If confirmed, we may submit representment for disputed amounts.
Dana (Billing): Uploaded merchant email + script to /shared/finance/onboardly/1918005555 and added portal note: "Micro chargebacks under investigation - possible QA leakage."
Pri (FinOps): Provisional approval to reverse micro refunds up to $45 if merchant formally confirms accidental tests and provides full audit trail. Need Legal sign-off for representment.
Jules (Support): Merchant said they'll provide signed attestation and a list of test txns within 2 business hours.
chargeback-bot: Reminder scheduled in 12h for evidence follow-up.
Marco (Risk): If merchant cannot provide proof, escalate to fraud ops for further action (possible termination of merchant account and seek recovery).
Dana (Billing): I'll keep the hold and post updates here when evidence arrives. Thanks team.
